== Biography ==

The Mouse is a creature of Wonderland who appears to hold authority among its inhabitants. When Alice encounters it in the pool, the Mouse regards her with an inquisitive expression and winks with one of its little eyes, though it does not speak at first. The Mouse, however, is fluent in English.

Among the animals gathered after their swim, the Mouse assumes a commanding presence. It calls upon the others to sit and listen, and they obey at once, arranging themselves in a large ring with the Mouse positioned in the center. Speaking with an important air, the Mouse promises to dry them all, claiming to know "the driest thing" for accomplishing this task.

== Relationships ==

'''[[Alice]]''' — wary_alliance. Alice seems to regard the Mouse as a potential guide when caught in the pool and follows it to shore, though the connection appears tentative and cautious.

'''[[Lory]]''' — acquaintance. The Mouse appears among the same gathering of wet animals as the Lory, though any true relationship between them remains unclear.

''Evolution:''
* [[Alice]] — Wary alliance (ch.2→ch.3)<ref>Alice's Adventures in Wonderland, chapter 2</ref>
